currentParagraphText: “Which only raises more questions,” Eversmile said, looking deep in thought. “That Chosen of yours isn’t exactly someone with the kind of mindset and mental state I would expect to see from someone seeking enlightenment. He is no monk, no philosopher, yet he’s surpassed all of them in the aspect that’s meant to be their speciality. At first, I theorized his Bloodline was the cause, and while I don’t doubt it’s involved somehow, I do not see it being the main factor.”
